summary: Sure is an index finger that moves straight forward from the lips, the same sign as TRUE and REALLY. A nod makes it an agreement.
steps: Hold an index finger upright in front of your lips, palm facing sideways.
Move it straight forward a few inches.
Nod for 'sure, okay.' Raise your eyebrows instead to ask 'really?'
mistakes: Touching the lips and stopping. The forward motion is the sign.
